title: Bound element-tree depth and node count against a stack-overflow DoS

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0071 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-24 directive 'dale al merge y a lo que sigue' — the fifth hardening fix, closing the element-nesting stack-overflow finding. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0071.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors and the 2026-08-24 user directive.

claims.statement: The hardening audit found that the element schema is recursive (children references the element schema), so the compiled Ajv validator recurses on validation; an unbounded, deeply-nested ElementNode tree could overflow the call stack on any path that validates one — POST /api/elements, POST /api/scenes, POST /api/scenes/activate and the WS component_deploy and scene_activate handlers.
claims.evidence: server/src/validation/schemas/element.schema.json recursive children definition; the 2026-08-24 hardening-audit finding hardening-element-nesting-bound.

claims.statement: The change adds an iterative (explicit-stack) pre-check, boundElementTree, that rejects a tree exceeding MAX_ELEMENT_DEPTH (64 levels) or MAX_ELEMENT_NODES (20000 nodes), run before the Ajv validator in validateElementNode and validateSceneNode. It follows both element children and scene elements arrays, short-circuits at the depth limit, and never recurses itself.
claims.evidence: server/src/validation/validator.ts boundElementTree and its use in validateElementNode and validateSceneNode.

claims.statement: Governed discovery required the guard itself to be iterative — a recursive guard would overflow on the same malicious input — and to run before the Ajv validator, so the recursive validator (and the downstream recursive render and clone helpers) never see an over-deep tree.
claims.evidence: boundElementTree uses an explicit stack and runs as the first statement of validateElementNode/validateSceneNode.

claims.statement: Rejecting an element nested past 64 levels, a 100000-deep tree without throwing, a tree exceeding 20000 nodes, and a scene whose elements nest too deep, while a valid shallow element still passes, proves the bound closes the stack-overflow DoS.

The 64-level depth and 20000-node limits are generous for real scenes (which are shallow with far fewer elements); the guard covers the element and scene validation entry points, and downstream recursive render or clone helpers are protected because an over-deep tree is rejected before reaching them.
claims.evidence: The full server suite of real scene and element fixtures passes unchanged under the new bound.

claims.statement: Human review accepted CHG-0071: a deeply-nested or huge ElementNode tree is rejected by an iterative depth/node-count guard (64 levels, 20000 nodes) before the recursive Ajv validator, so it cannot overflow the stack; a 100000-deep tree is rejected without throwing and valid shallow trees still pass.
claims.evidence: server/src/validation/validator.ts, server/tests/unit/elementNestingBound.test.ts, the passing full server suite under npm run check, the CHG-0071 pull-request Constitution run (8 jobs green), and human acceptance on 2026-08-24.

claims.statement: The change is server-only and additive: a validation pre-check and a test. No protocol or Studio change and no existing behavior regresses.
claims.evidence: git diff of the CHG-0071 branch: server/src/validation/validator.ts and server/tests/unit/elementNestingBound.test.ts.

successCriteria.statement: A tree nested past the depth limit or exceeding the node-count limit is rejected before the recursive validator runs.
successCriteria.verification: Tests assert validateElementNode rejects a 69-deep element and a 20001-node tree with a bounded reason, and validateSceneNode rejects a scene whose elements nest too deep.

successCriteria.statement: A very deep tree is rejected without overflowing the stack.
successCriteria.verification: A test validates a 100000-deep element and asserts it does not throw and returns a non-null bounded error.

successCriteria.statement: Valid shallow trees still pass and no existing behavior regresses.
successCriteria.verification: A test asserts a valid shallow element validates to null; the full server suite passes.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0071 records the element-nesting DoS finding and its iterative-bound fix before implementation.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: An iterative depth and node-count guard runs before the Ajv validator on the element and scene validation paths.
Tests prove rejection past the limits, no stack overflow on a very deep tree, and that valid trees pass; the full server suite passes.
Governance, licensing, lint, type-check, focused and full tests, build, dependency audit and diff checks pass before handoff.
definitionOfDone.evidence: npm run governance:check, npm run check, npm run build, npm audit (0 vulnerabilities), ESLint, type-check and git diff --check; the accept commit is verified by its own pull-request Constitution run before merge.
